player_prompt.intro:
E te tagata taʻalo {player_id} e taʻalo se taʻaloga o Pig Dice.

Tulafono:
- I luga o lau turn, e mafai ona e '[roll]' poʻo '[hold]'
- Tuʻuga 2-6: Faʻaopoopo i lau tuʻuga o le turn
- Tuʻuga 1: Faʻauma lau tuʻuga o le turn ma faʻaiʻu turn
- Tuʻu: Faʻaopoopo lau tuʻuga o le turn i lau skoa ma faʻaiʻu turn
- Muamua e alu i {winning_score} puna e naʻi ai

A o luʻi turn, e te vaʻai i skoa faʻavae ma tuʻuga o le turn.
Tali ma '[roll]' e tuʻuga le paʻepaʻe poʻo '[hold]' e faʻamaonia lau puna.

actions.player_busted: Taaloga {player_id} ua faaletonu, ua leiloa {turn_total} togi!
actions.player_hold: Tagata taʻalo {player_id} tuʻu ma faʻamaonia {turn_total} puna.

board.current_total_scores: Faʻamatalaga o le taimi nei: {scores} O lau aofaʻi atoa i le taimi lenei e {turn_total}.
